title: Sexual Assault and Aggravated Sexual Assault
grade_or_penalty: Aggravated sexual assault: 1st degree. Sexual assault: 2nd degree
key_points: Aggravated: sexual penetration with a victim under 13, or with aggravators such as a weapon, severe injury, during another serious crime, help from others, or a helpless or incapacitated victim.

Sexual assault: penetration using physical force or coercion without severe injury, sexual contact with a child under 13 by an actor at least 4 years older, or penetration with a 13-15 year old by an actor at least 4 years older, among other circumstances.
elements: The suspect committed an act of sexual penetration with the victim

Plus one of the statute's circumstances, for example: physical force or coercion; a victim under 13; a 13-15 year old victim with an actor at least 4 years older; or a helpless or incapacitated victim
For aggravated sexual assault, identify the aggravating circumstance (weapon, severe injury, during another crime, aided by others, etc.)
